title: Apprise api (LinuxServer.io)
description: Apprise-api Takes advantage of Apprise through your network with a user-friendly Api. * Send notifications to more than 100 services. * An incredibly lightweight gateway to Apprise. * A production ready micro-service at your disposal. * A Simple Website to verify and test your configuration with. Apprise Api was designed to easily fit into existing (and new) eco-systems that are looking for a simple notification solution.
